info.description: User API and V2Box machine API. Administrative, operations and legacy node contracts remain available separately. The unfinished staff API is retired.

get.description: A recognized subscription User-Agent with client subscription access enabled is required. Unknown or unlisted clients receive 403 FORBIDDEN. Retired flag parameters, legacy format aliases, General and incompatible formats receive 422 VALIDATION_FAILED. Per-IP and shared per-account limits return 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After. Application and engine minimum versions are checked independently. Authenticated /me/client-config uses its own dedicated-client policy.

post.description: Provider-native signature verification and response. Payment notifications are idempotent; Telegram requires X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token. New payments use V10 callback URLs, including custom callback domains. Old payment callbacks remain compatible for existing orders. Historical callback URLs remain supported. The bot must be enabled with a nonempty configured token; disabled, unconfigured or invalid credentials return 401.

get.description: Provider-native signature verification and response. Payment notifications are idempotent; Telegram requires X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token. New payments use V10 callback URLs, including custom callback domains. Old payment callbacks remain compatible for existing orders. Historical callback URLs remain supported. PaytaroQR verifies X-App-Secret and requires positive order_amount (major units, up to two decimal places) and order_currency. Original order amount is converted to integer minor units and compared with the stored order total plus its payment fee snapshot; pay_amount/pay_currency are not settlement inputs. Valid and matching duplicate callbacks retain the native success response; invalid amount or currency returns the native failure response.

get.description: Published third-party mirror or uploaded FastAI installer download. FastAI IDs use the fastai- UUID prefix. Uploaded drafts and historical packages not in the current release catalog return 404; current FastAI access/version policy applies. Supports HEAD and byte ranges; binary content is not enveloped. Unknown IDs return 404.

Requires an active session. Order and ticket identifiers are checked against the authenticated owner. Unauthenticated: 401; banned account: 403. FastAI native YAML uses default.fastai.yaml or custom.fastai.yaml, independently of public subscription templates. Only real proxy nodes are emitted; subscription information nodes and subscription-userinfo headers are omitted. Account information is read through the account/subscription JSON APIs. Geo databases are bundled with FastAI; automatic Geo updates and remote HTTP rule providers are prohibited, including custom templates.
